title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Michal Jaworski…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the WordPress plugin 'Track, Analyze & Optimize by WP Tao' up to version 1.3.1. This vulnerability allows attackers to inject malicious scripts that are stored and later executed in users' browsers when they view affected pages.
